title: Whole-phrase rhythm: first listening experiment
playback_note: The same generated melodic idea is recomposed across all eight bars. Compare the untouched original with two new rhythmic treatments at the same 150 BPM, GM guitar and gain. Recognizable melodic anchors, chord order and the final descending answer are retained while repeated notes are condensed or repeated differently. These are source-informed composition experiments, not a trained rhythm model or the finished browser lever. Sound quality and musical preference are for listening review.
questions: Which direction would you keep developing: Cross-bar pulse or Space and bursts?
Does each version feel like a coherent new phrase while retaining the melodic idea?
Where does the rhythm feel awkward, predictable or unrelated to the references?
